personas.name: The Quiet Connector
personas.profile: $400K HHI, spends on what compounds. Two kids, 9 and 12. Soccer sideline, porch coffee, house project.

wants.want: A way to be away from his usual social circles.
wants.today: a coffeeshop near the house, or the office

wants.want: Running into someone he hasn't seen in a while.
A space that reminds him of freer times.
wants.today: the driving range, a lakefront patio

wants.want: Wellness on Monday morning, before work.
wants.today: at home, a small private gym

personas.give: The café, the lounge, the events space. Wellness and the bays. Featured chefs, poker nights, golf-focused pilates — and leagues that give you somewhere to go even when you don't have friends.

personas.name: The Country-Club Guy
personas.profile: $600K+, asset-rich. Teens at home. 7:40 tee time, home by noon, lake with the kids. Already belongs somewhere.

wants.want: A simulator that's free when he wants it.
Dropping in without the long commute.
Thursday night poker.
wants.today: a friend's house, a private room at Daniel's

wants.want: Wellness — most clubs don't offer it.
wants.today: a scheduled appointment with his wife

personas.give: Bookings he can plan around — an 8am bay before work. Demo days, whiskey launches, Bandon and Pebble. Deliberately slower programming: visits over two hours.

personas.name: The Semi-Retired Operator
personas.profile: $2M+ net worth, lives off investments and board fees. Grown kids, first grandchild. Two boards, one advisory role.

wants.want: Meeting younger, more interesting people.
Being a practical mentor to someone.
Being valued and noticed for it.
Throwing something impromptu on a Friday.

personas.give: A named role and a real position in the club. He organizes programming, recruits teams, hosts member dinners — and we say publicly that he is the one who made it happen.

personas.name: The New-to-Seattle Founder
personas.profile: $250K plus equity. Newly married, no kids, a dog. New restaurant, one hike, Sunday work.

wants.want: A true second space.
Somewhere to take video calls.
Somewhere to meet investors.
People who aren't colleagues.
wants.today: meetups, affinity groups, friends of friends

personas.give: The lounge as workspace and as the default "meet me at." A room mixed on purpose — professions, genders, backgrounds. Events with the top Seattle companies, one-offs, short-format matches.

personas.name: The Empty-Nester
personas.profile: $500K HHI, house paid off, college fund done. Kids in their 20s. Long breakfast, garden, dinner with two other couples.

wants.want: Reconnecting with the hobbies they dropped.
wants.today: the arts centre, the mall, a purchase

wants.want: Friends who match the life they have now.
Seeing people without hosting at home.
Being respected for what they know.

personas.give: Cohorts that start the game on the same day, so nobody is behind. Leadership called out by name, and accolades worth winning. Private space to book — book clubs, birthdays, corporate parties.

personas.name: The Mid-Career High Earner
personas.profile: $450K single or $700K dual, no dependents. Senior IC or top firm. Run, brunch, date night, side project.

wants.want: A third place.
Plans that are certain when she needs them to be.
People to watch the game with.
wants.today: a sports bar, the work text group

wants.want: Knowing the next thing before it's the next thing.

personas.give: Guest passes, and the generosity of bringing people. Athlete and brand nights, demo sessions, date nights worth choosing. Faster programming — in and out in sixty to ninety minutes.
